definition: Datasets loads, streams and processes ML datasets from the Hugging Face Hub or local files, backed by Apache Arrow.
details: Developed by Hugging Face (Quentin Lhoest, Thomas Wolf and team) since 2020.

explainer.lead: How to install Hugging Face Datasets, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from datasets import load_dataset

ds = load_dataset("imdb", split="train")
ds = ds.filter(lambda row: len(row["text"]) < 2000)
ds = ds.map(lambda row: {"n_words": len(row["text"].split())})
print(ds[0]["n_words"], ds.num_rows)

explainer.inAi: Prepare fine-tuning and evaluation data; streaming=True lets you iterate over corpora too big to download.
explainer.jsNote: Python only. From JavaScript, @huggingface/hub can download dataset files, and the Hub’s dataset viewer has a REST API.
